exposure.needed: whether cert-manager performs FindZoneByFqdn DNS zone-discovery lookups at runtime (e.g. while solving DNS challenges) and the TTLs of the responses being cached

consequence.statement: DNS zone discovery via FindZoneByFqdn still works but now caches the full DNS response and expires cached entries according to TTL; the evidence describes no failure, rejection, or required operator step.
consequence.remediation: No operator action is indicated by the evidence; the caching change is internal to DNS zone discovery.

assertion.statement: In cert-manager 1.18.0, FindZoneByFqdn now caches the full DNS response and handles TTL expiration of the cached response during DNS zone discovery.
